description: Bulk enable or disable integration models, register custom or fine-tuned models, set per-model hosts and headers, and attach static token pricing. allow_all_models controls whether future provider models start enabled. These changes affect every workspace using the integration; inspect list_integration_models first and use get_model_pricing when deriving custom rates. Returns success and the number of models updated.

allow_all_models.description: Whether newly available provider models are enabled by default

models.description: Array of model configurations to update

base_model_slug.description: Base model slug for a fine-tuned model

configurations.description: Per-model custom upstream host and headers

custom_headers.description: Headers sent only for this model; values may contain secrets

custom_host.description: Custom upstream URL used only for this model

is_custom.description: Whether this is a custom model (default: false)

is_finetune.description: Whether this entry is a fine-tuned model

model_name.description: Display name for the model (required for custom models)

pricing_config.description: Static custom pricing for this integration model

pay_as_you_go.description: Pay-as-you-go rates for this integration model

price.description: Static price per token in the integration pricing unit
Static price per token in the integration pricing unit

name: update_integration_models

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
